text: Understood. Two things: (1) the pacing fix is live in the engine run that started 01:58, so it can spend only about a day's share (roughly 9,000 credits a day of what's left on the 100,000 key) instead of the month-so-far; (2) most of tonight's extra burn was my restarts, since each cold scan re-reads every league and its props. I'm done restarting for now. I'll look at the engine's per-league ParlayAPI spend over the next scans and cut whatever is read more often than its data changes, then tell you what I changed.
